prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: entire office floor illustration for an interactive desktop software-company agent dashboard. Reference image establishes only the elegant soft 2.5D isometric illustration style, natural daylight, pale wood desks, slate upholstered chairs, frosted glass, plants, white/ice blue palette. Expand the office into a spacious WIDE 16:9 cutaway office with EIGHT DISTINCT TEAM CORNERS and exactly 31 seated diverse adult employees, every person recognizable and unobstructed, desks organized in neat clusters with broad clear corridors. View near overhead axonometric, less perspective distortion, all desks/persons at consistent scale. Zone layout in TWO ROWS of FOUR separate islands: top row from LEFT to RIGHT: Management 2 people, Product 3 people, Design 4 people, Engineering 8 people (two rows of four desks). Bottom row from LEFT to RIGHT: Game Studio 3 people, Data/AI 2 people, Operations 3 people, Quality 6 people (two rows of three desks). Every island visually distinct by subtle small colored rugs or acoustic partition accents: management slateblue, product sage, design dustyrose, engineering cobalt, game amber, dataAI teal, operations lavender, quality mint. Reviewers have their own workstation within the corresponding team. Leave clear empty space directly above each island for native department headings, and directly under individual desks for small native name badges. Comfortable large canvas where each of 31 people can be clicked. Quiet seated idle poses with screens, pens, plant accents. Keep people/heads visible, no tall monitors hiding them. Minimal outer window/wall border and few plants only, no extra vacant desks, no huge meeting room. Entire company floor fits with 4% padding. High resolution 3840x2160-style landscape. IMPORTANT: illustration only, NO app UI, NO sidebar, NO topbar, NO panels, NO labels, NO letters, NO text anywhere, NO speech bubbles, NO status dots or connector lines. Avoid crowded overlapping figures, tiny illegible details, photo-realism, saturated game graphics. Preserve premium calm editorial illustration quality of reference.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this software-company office illustration to make the actual OFFICE FLOOR substantially larger and more spacious. Preserve exact premium 2.5D illustration style, all 31 distinct people at their desks, eight team islands and the same arrangement/colors: top row Management2, Product3, Design4, Engineering8; bottom row Game3, DataAI2, Operations3, Quality6. Expand the cutaway office footprint by roughly 50 percent. Give all team islands wide corridors of clear pale floor BETWEEN them, more perimeter margin, none touching or clipped by outside edges, and clearly separate corners for each team. Add a small EMPTY round meeting table and four empty chairs in the broad central corridor only if it fits without crowding. Keep comfortable generous desk/person scale and visible heads. Compose a WIDE 2:1 panoramic whole office high resolution 3840x1920-style, entire exterior perimeter and every desk/chair visible with 6 percent safe margins. Slight more top-down camera, bright natural windows, sparse potted plants and glass partitions outside. Keep ample unobstructed negative space over and under each team island for native HTML department headings and staff badges. No additional employees, no text/letters/labels, no dashboard UI, no status/bubbles/lines. The goal is a larger professional software company floor, not merely shrinking desks on the same crowded layout.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Add tasteful real office amenities and walkway decoration to this spacious software-company floor illustration. PRESERVE exact eight team island desk locations, each of 31 people, their scale and appearance, window walls, room footprint, 2:1 composition and light calm 2.5D illustration style. Only enrich the large empty central corridor and sparse perimeter. Make readable broad WALKING ROUTES in light warm ivory/stone tiles with subtle sage trim, extending along the central horizontal corridor and vertical gaps between the islands, no digital arrows. In central corridor LEFT add a refined comfortable BREAK LOUNGE: small soft cream curved sofa, two lounge chairs and low rounded coffee table with tea pot, ceramic cups and a couple books, pale textured rug, small standing lamp and plant, all EMPTY. In central corridor RIGHT add a compact elegant pantry/DRINKS area: pale wood bar counter, coffee machine, tea kettle, neat cups, under-counter glass-door mini beer fridge with a few amber beer bottles/cans visible, 3 barstools, tiny plant. Retain existing central small round meeting table without crowding paths. These three amenities must be modest enough to keep generous clear circulation, all team desks visible and unobstructed. Add a few perimeter plants, tidy shelves only where there is space. No additional people, no change to staff islands, NO text, labels, logos, appUI, speechbubbles, statuses, connector lines. Professional cozy software company, visually appealing and spacious, not restaurant/nightclub. Keep all furniture safely inside the canvas and glass perimeter.
